title: 第十三章太极魔身这是要让我当邪修啊第十四章 重伤叶夕瑶的在次拜访
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 李长寿看了一眼大门，只恨自己不会阵法，也没有什么保命的手段。
若是发生大战，必然会波及他们一家三口。
不对...准确的来说是四口，还有千凡腹中的胎儿。
“唉，还真是个小冤家，你一个皇城家族的人，来我这破庙作甚。”
吐槽一声，李长寿便走出房间，打开大门。
“老爷子，跑得这么快，还说不折腾？”
刚一开门，叶夕瑶身体前倾，俏皮地对着他笑了笑。
“有事吗？没事的话就请离开吧！”李长寿冷漠地开口，他是真的一秒钟都不想和她掺和了。
“唉唉唉，有句话叫做伸手不打笑脸人，你关门作甚。”
叶夕瑶看到对方关门动作，急忙用小手抵住了门，并一个闪身从高墙上跳了进来。
“放心，我就是来看看，如果你还要住在这里的话，顺便告诉你一个秘密。”
他也算是看出来了，自己想要拦住她是不可能了。
对方的态度摇摆不定，李长寿只能警惕地跟在她的后面。
等到这次过后，他一定要抽空学习阵法。
至少不能让叶夕瑶一个翻身跨过墙壁。
来到房间，叶夕瑶发现周围平平无奇，家具朴实无华。
还真像是正常凡人居住的家，没有一丁点仙灵之气。
唯一吸引人的就是那吃剩的一桌菜，她没有任何拘谨，拿起旁边的碗筷就吃了起来。
完全没有大小姐的样子，有一种饿疯流民的感觉。
‘看来系统给出的词条还真不是盖的，真是一个货真价实的吃货。’
李长寿捂着头，正想着如何把她送走。
叶夕瑶吧嗒着小嘴，笑了笑：“老爷子不用拘谨，当成自己家就行。”
“直接说吧！”李长寿轻咳两声，原谅了对方的无礼：“你说的秘密是什么？”
叶夕瑶一口干完十全大补汤，满足地摸了摸隆起的腹部。
“老爷子可曾知道万魂宗？”
“他们最近在黑风城偷偷地布置阵法，待到阵法完成，这里可就是一座死城了。”
万魂宗，这个名字在李长寿脑海中是陌生的。
结合这阴森的名字和那诡异的阵法，毫无疑问这是个邪修宗门。
他的修为并不弱，竟然丁点察觉都没有。
“不过是一些邪修，老朽当然知道。”
李长寿面无表情，气定神闲地喝了口茶，露出一副高人的形象。
有着苟道神术的掩护，对方显然是没有看穿他的修为。
倒不如好好利用这层滤镜，说不定能够讨出一些有用的话语。
叶夕瑶听到这话，饶有兴趣地看向李长寿：“终于藏不住了吗？”
“如果万魂宗真的对黑风城动手，老爷子你会出手吗？”
李长寿想了一下，随后说道：“当然不会，老朽不愿沾染因果，全城的人与我何干。”
得知李长寿要跑路，叶夕瑶内心五味杂陈。
‘不应该啊，按照话本里面写的，这种隐藏的前辈都会拯救百姓，灭掉邪修。’
‘不愿意沾染因果要跑路是什么鬼？’
‘万魂宗的计划仅靠本小姐一人无法阻止，只能再寻找其他帮手了。’
content_en:
Li Changshou glanced at the door and regretted that he didn't know the formation and had no means of saving his life.
If a war breaks out, it will definitely affect their family of three.
No... to be precise, four, and the fetus in Qianfan's belly.
"Oh, what a little enemy. You, a member of the Imperial City family, why are you here in my ruined temple?"
After complaining, Li Changshou walked out of the room and opened the door.
"Old man, you're running so fast and you're still saying you won't bother?"
As soon as he opened the door, Ye Xiyao leaned forward and smiled playfully at him.
"Is something wrong? If nothing happens, please leave!" Li Changshou said indifferently. He really didn't want to get involved with her for a second.
"Alas, alas, there is a saying that you can't reach out to hit someone with a smiling face. Why are you closing the door?"
Ye Xiyao saw the other party closing the door and hurriedly held the door with her little hand, then jumped in from the high wall.
Li Changshou: "..."
"Don't worry, I'm just here to take a look. If you still want to live here, I'll tell you a secret."
He could finally see that it was impossible for him to stop her.
The other party's attitude was wavering, and Li Changshou could only follow her vigilantly.
After this time, he must find time to learn the formation.
At least Ye Xiyao couldn't be allowed to turn over and cross the wall.
Arriving at the room, Ye Xiyao found that the surroundings were unremarkable and the furniture was unpretentious.
It really looks like a home where normal mortals live, without the slightest bit of fairy spirit.
The only attractive thing was the leftover food on the table. She picked up the bowls and chopsticks next to her and started eating without any restraint.
She doesn't look like a young lady at all, she has the feeling of a starving refugee.
'It seems that the entries given by the system are really not fake. He is really a real foodie. ’
Li Changshou covered his head and was thinking about how to send her away.
Ye Xiyao pursed her lips and smiled: "Master, don't be cautious, just treat it as your own home."
"Just tell me!" Li Changshou coughed twice and forgave the other party's rudeness: "What is the secret you are talking about?"
Ye Xiyao finished the Shiquan Dabu Decoction in one gulp and touched her bulging belly with satisfaction.
"Has the old man ever known about the Ten Thousand Souls Sect?"
"They have secretly set up a formation in Black Wind City recently. When the formation is completed, this place will be a dead city."
The name Wanhun Sect was unfamiliar to Li Changshou.
Combined with the eerie name and the weird formation, there is no doubt that this is an evil cultivating sect.
His cultivation was not weak, and he didn't even notice it at all.
"They are just some evil cultivators. Of course I know that."
Li Changshou had no expression on his face and took a sip of tea calmly, showing the image of a master.
With the cover of Gou Dao's magic, the other party obviously didn't see through his cultivation level.
It's better to make good use of this filter, maybe you can come up with some useful words.
When Ye Xiyao heard this, she looked at Li Changshou with interest: "Can't you finally hide it?"
"If the Ten Thousand Souls Sect really takes action against Black Wind City, will you take action, old man?"
Li Changshou thought for a moment and then said: "Of course not. I don't want to be tainted by karma. What do the people in the city have to do with me."
Ye Xiyao felt mixed emotions when she learned that Li Changshou was going to run away.
‘It shouldn’t be. According to what is written in the storybook, such hidden seniors will save the people and destroy evil cultivators. ’
‘What’s the point of running away if you don’t want to be contaminated by karma? ’
‘The plan of the Ten Thousand Souls Sect cannot be stopped by me alone, so we can only look for other helpers. ’
title_en: Chapter 13: The Tai Chi Demon Body wants me to be an evil cultivator. Chapter 14: The visit of Ye Xiyao who was seriously injured.
